Definition
[Eigenvalue and eigenvector] ↗ def:resolvent-set-spectrum-appendix-d 1. appD:D.3-def-5\group Functional Analysis

(i) A point $\eta \in \sigma (A)$ is an eigenvalue if \[ N(A-\eta I) e \{ 0\} . \] The set of eigenvalues is the point spectrum $\sigma _p(A)$.

(ii) If $w e 0$ and $Aw=\eta w$, then $w$ is an eigenvector associated with $\eta $.
